texts.note: Selected letters of Ñāṇavīra Thera, free from his estate. The accessible entry point to his thought — existential, direct, often funny. Good first Ñāṇavīra text for readers new to the lineage.
texts.title: The Tragic, the Comic and the Personal — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF/EPUB)

texts.note: Ñāṇavīra's argument that nibbāna is a state here-and-now, not a metaphysical escape. Core to the early-suttas lineage's non-standard reading of anattā.
texts.title: Nibbāna and Anattā — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF/EPUB)

texts.note: Early essay on rebirth through the lens of dependent origination rather than a soul-transmigration model.
texts.title: Sketch for a Proof of Rebirth — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF/EPUB)

texts.note: Ethics grounded in seeing, not rules. Pairs with the 'seeing dukkha directly' practice family.
texts.title: The Foundation of Ethics — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF)

texts.note: Working notebook — his rawest notes. For advanced study only; not a teaching text.
texts.title: Commonplace Book — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF)

texts.note: Ñāṇavīra's margin notes on Heidegger, Sartre, etc. Shows his philosophical anchors.
texts.title: Marginalia — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF)

texts.note: Sutta and existentialism side by side. Shows how the early-suttas reading bridges Pali and Western existential thought.
texts.title: Suttas & Sartre — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free PDF)

texts.note: Ajahn Ñāṇamoli Thero's expanded essays from talks. The clearest modern presentation of the early-suttas approach — signless concentration, kāya-passāna, right view as lived seeing.
texts.title: Dhamma Within Reach — Ajahn Ñāṇamoli Thero (free PDF)

texts.licence: free PDF (BPS digital edition, Access to Insight)
texts.note: Ñāṇamoli Thera's translation of Buddhaghosa's Visuddhimagga. The classical shamatha-vipassanā manual. The early-suttas lineage reads it critically but respects its system.
texts.title: The Path of Purification (Visuddhimagga) — Ñāṇamoli tr. (free BPS PDF)

texts.note: How the mind builds conceptual reality and how to see through it. Pairs with dependent origination practice; the theory under the early-suttas seeing.
texts.title: Concept and Reality in Early Buddhism — Katukurunde Ñāṇananda (BPS)

texts.note: Signless concentration and the limitation of perceptions. The practice core of Ñāṇananda's work — pairs directly with the signless-concentration practice family.
texts.title: The Magic of the Mind — Katukurunde Ñāṇananda (BPS)

texts.note: Nibbāna as experienced, not theorised. The culmination text of Ñāṇananda's trilogy.
texts.title: Nibbāna – The Mind Stilled — Katukurunde Ñāṇananda (BPS)

texts.note: Ñāṇadīpa Thera's selection from the Sutta Nipāta — the archaic core of the Pali canon that the early-suttas lineage privileges.
texts.title: The Silent Sages of Old — Ñāṇadīpa Thera (free PDF)

texts.note: The Aṭṭhakavagga (Sutta Nipāta ch. 4) with commentary by Bhikkhu Paññobhāsa. The foundational text of the early-suttas approach — non-clinging to views.
texts.title: The Aṭṭhakavagga — Bhikkhu Paññobhāsa (free, Path Press)

texts.note: The Sutta on Non-Attraction to Views. The core Aṭṭhakavagga discourse — the practice of not taking any view as 'mine'. Verify with FoJin get_parallels for the Chinese Āgama parallel.
texts.title: Snp 4.11 Dhātuvibhaṅga Sutta — SuttaCentral (Sujato, CC0)

texts.note: The faculties (indriya) including the signless concentration — the sutta basis for the early-suttas signless practice. Cross-check with FoJin.
texts.title: SN 48.10 Indriya Sutta — SuttaCentral (Sujato, CC0)

texts.note: The four establishments of mindfulness. The core text behind all satipatthāna-based practices in the graph.
texts.title: MN 10 Satipaṭṭhāna Sutta — SuttaCentral (Sujato, CC0)

texts.note: The One-by-One Discourse — detailed jhāna progression. Key text for the jhana track; cited in Burbea and by the early-suttas lineage.
texts.title: MN 111 Anupada Sutta — SuttaCentral (Sujato, CC0)

texts.note: Bhikkhu Bodhi's Majjhima translation of the bases for mindfulness; also free on dhammatalks.
texts.title: MN 131 Basileadhamma Sutta (Bhikkhu Bodhi, dhammatalks)

texts.note: The two faculties — faith and wisdom, concentration and effort. Foundational for balancing effort and ease.
texts.title: AN 2.188 Indriya Sutta — SuttaCentral (Sujato, CC0)

texts.note: Anaylayo comparative study of MN 10 and its Chinese Madhyama-agama parallel. Free PDF. The best single entry into the early-suttas satipatthana material.
texts.title: Satipatthana: The Direct Path to Realization - Bhikkhu Analayo (free PDF)

texts.note: The 33-lecture BCBS retreat: Analayo's line-by-line analysis of Katukurunde Nanananda's Nibbana - The Mind Stilled. Each lecture has a downloadable PDF transcript. Read alongside the original Nanananda book. Analayo reads the Pali against Chinese and Tibetan parallels.
texts.title: Nibbana: The Mind Stilled - Bhikkhu Analayo (33-lecture analysis of Nanananda, free PDFs)

texts.note: Comparative studies of the Samyukta-agama - the Chinese parallel collection. Unique in showing what is common and what differs between the Pali and Chinese early traditions.
texts.title: Samyukta-agama Studies - Bhikkhu Analayo (free PDFs at uni-hamburg)

texts.note: Complete VBT translation by Christopher Wallis (Hareesh), free PDF. 112 practices, direct from Sanskrit. The base translation his blog analyses reference. Satsang: the 2018 first-draft PDF; the translator says it has since been considerably improved (final translation in Tantra 112).
texts.title: VBT Complete Translation - Christopher Wallis (Hareesh), free PDF

texts.note: Ongoing verse-by-verse analysis of the VBT on Hareesh's free blog. Verses 1-57+ covered, with Sanskrit, translation, practice notes, and Abhinavagupta's upaya framework. The lecture-analysis layer for the VBT.
texts.title: VBT Blog Series - Christopher Wallis (Hareesh), free verse-by-verse analysis

texts.note: Master translation concordance comparing 8 English + 2 French + 1 German + 1 Spanish VBT translations verse by verse, with upaya categorization (aṇava/śākta/śāmbhava) and difficulty levels. The single most useful reference for understanding how different translators read the VBT.
texts.title: VBT Translation Concordance Part 1 - Christopher Wallis, free

texts.note: Baumer translation + Lakshman Joo oral commentary, Indica Books 2002. Copyrighted but Archive PDF is publicly available. The Lakshman Joo commentary layer - his direct oral teaching edited from transcript.
texts.title: VBT: The Practice of Centring Awareness - Baumer tr. + Lakshman Joo commentary (Archive PDF)

texts.note: All 112 VBT practices in full, translated by Hareesh, free to read online with printable PDF. The web version of the free translation.
texts.title: Tantra112 - Full VBT text, all 112 practices, free
